'''Ryan Patterson''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 87 from Mansfield, Oh. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. At DecipherCon 1999 he also played [[Young Jedi]], finishing 37th in YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck).<ref name="dc99yj02_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108185300/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html Internet Archive]</ref>

He became a director in February 1998, ran weekly tournaments in Mansfield, Ohio with help from [[James Ray]], and ran the SWCCG events at AndCon 98 in Toledo.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
I became a director back in February of '98, and thanks to Jim Ray, a Gold Squadron member (sorry Jim, I forgot your number), I got off to a good start with running tournaments.

A recent tournament highlight was our running Star Wars CCG tournaments at AndCon 98 in Toledo, Ohio.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
